title: Barrel

fields.label: Function
fields.value: Used to transport items without the worry of items falling out

body:
"Barrels can be used to store loose items and move them over long distances without accidentally spilling them, this variant can hold a total of 2x2. Anchoring the barrel will anchor everything inside of the crate automatically."

Description

The Barrel costs $450 and can be found near Dugg's Digging. When used, it'll allow you to carry items across the map without the worry of dropping items.
